achievement today._

Good morning! **Andrew** here. Perhaps you thought this before, but have you
noticed since **Donald Trump** launched his war with Iran that he _really,
really_ doesn't care if every American - and well, everyone around the globe -
suffers? Relatedly, does anyone know how to make a campaign ad?

There is no paywall in this installment of **' First Draft'** thanks to
today's sponsor, **[Ground News](https://ground.news/)**!

In today's **' First Draft,' **we review Trump's history of saying _on camera_
that he knew gas prices would go higher, potentially a lot higher, and he
launched his war anyway. Plus, a U.S. judge blocks sanctions against United
Nations special rapporteur **Francesca Albanese** for investigating Israel's
war crimes in Gaza, and Trump's favorite Democrat, attention-seeker **John
Fetterman** , casts the key vote to keep the Iran war going.

# 'I Expected Worse'

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!zo3q!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-
post-

speaks to the press as he departs the White House on May 12, 2026. Photo by
Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images._

Donald Trump won in 2024, [in large
part](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-features/why-kamala-
harris-lost-election-2024-1235154713/), because Americans didn't like the
Biden-era economy, and the higher prices that followed the worst of the
COVID-19 pandemic.

**" Starting on day one, we will end inflation,"** Trump pledged on the
campaign trail, as he promised to drive down energy prices and grocery prices
- while also [claiming](https://zeteo.com/p/team-trump-iran-war-regime-change)
he'd avoid disastrous regime-change wars in the Middle East.

As both top Trump and Kamala Harris campaign aides [have told
it](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-
features/campaign-2024-democrats-failure-1235230952/), the most effective
Trump campaign ads in 2024 revolved around the idea that she was _more of the
same_ , and video clips of the vice president arguing that **" Bidenomics is
working."**

That, of course, feels like a lifetime ago. As president now, Trump is leading
a financial WMD of a regime-change war that's seen Iran choke off the flow of
oil, sending diesel and gasoline prices soaring. Consumer inflation
accelerated last month - and it's likely about to [get much
worse](https://www.cnn.com/2026/05/13/economy/us-ppi-wholesale-inflation-
april), as wholesale prices have started to spike.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

 _And Trump couldn 't give a shit. _

That's not my opinion. Trump keeps screaming it out loud, on video, in the
middle of a midterm election cycle that would look very bad for Republicans if
they weren't trying so hard to eliminate Democratic congressional seats and
Black voting power in the South.

Asked Tuesday if Americans' financial situations were motivating him to make a
deal to end the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran, Trump
[said](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2054262313788768765): **" Not even a little
bit," **adding:** "I don't think about Americans' financial situation."**

  
If that, for some reason, sounds like it could be taken out of context, as
Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson
[suggested](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2054572871247130733) on Wednesday, or
sounds like a **" misrepresentation"** of what Trump said, as Vice President
JD Vance falsely
[claimed](https://x.com/acyn/status/2054632706454257884?s=46), there are many
similar clips of Trump sounding wholly unconcerned with the economic havoc
he's creating.

Since launching his war of choice, which has seen the price of gas increase by
more than 50% in the US, Trump has repeatedly said he expected oil prices
would go much higher.

**" We figured oil prices would go up, which they will," **he
[said](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-trump-press-
gaggle-air-force-one-march-7-2026/#41) on March 7, a week after launching his
war, or **" excursion,"** as he put it that day.

The national [average](https://www.nbcnews.com/data-graphics/gas-prices-iran-
war-state-national-cost-trump-rcna265835) gas price in the U.S. was $2.98 the
day Trump launched his war. It was $3.41 on March 7.

**" I expected worse, actually,"** Trump
[said](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-trump-press-
gaggle-before-marine-one-departure-march-20-2026/#104) later that month. **" I
thought that oil prices would go much higher."**

At his March 26 Cabinet meeting, Trump
[said](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-trump-remarks-
cabinet-meeting-march-26-2026/#50),** "I thought the oil prices would go up
more."** A day later, at a Saudi investment conference, Trump
[said](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-trump-speech-
saudi-investment-conference-florida-march-27-2026/#111), "**I thought oil
prices were going to go up higher than they are now. "** Gas was $3.98, a full
dollar higher nationally than it was before Trump's war.

On April 16, Trump dismissed the idea that Americans were facing high gas
prices. **" They're not very high,"** he
[told](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-trump-press-
gaggle-before-marine-one-departure-april-16-2026/#41) a reporter.

Speaking at The Villages in Florida on May 1, Trump
[said](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-trump-speech-
senior-citizens-the-villages-florida-may-1-2026/#95), **" I thought the oil
prices would go up much more," **adding, **" We have no choice whether it does
or doesn't, I have to do what's right."**

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/higher-gas-prices-trump-doesnt-
care?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

In a bizarre scene a week ago,
[surrounded](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-trump-
remarks-ufc-fighters-oval-office-may-6-2026/#79) by UFC fighters in the Oval
Office, Trump
[said](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2052102649110237682?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
he thought the price of a barrel of oil would be triple or nearly quadruple
what it was when he launched his Iran war. "**I thought oil prices would go to
$200, $250, it 's at $100 now,"** he said. **" Even if it went to $200, it
would have been worth it."**

The national gas price average was $4.54 that day.

On Tuesday, as [he
said](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-trump-press-
gaggle-before-marine-one-departure-may-12-2026/), **" I don't think about
Americans' financial situation,"** Trump added that **" a lot of people"**
thought oil prices would be even higher. **" It was $99 yesterday, which is
low, which is relatively low."**

As Trump remains so oddly impervious to Americans' economic pain, observers
step in to tell his public just how bad things are getting politically. On
Wednesday, CNN data guru Harry Enten
[greeted](https://x.com/RpsAgainstTrump/status/2054713129334951940) a new
report about annualized wholesale inflation up 6% with a disbelieving **"
Jesus…"** Then he went to town on just that one aspect of Trump's terrible
cost-of-living polling.

**" These are the ugliest numbers I have ever seen on inflation,"** Enten
said. **" And it's not just one poll… it's many polls. Just take a look here.
President's net approval on inflation, the five worst polls ever for any
president. They all belong to Donald John Trump, and they have all occurred in
the last month…**

**" It is a record. Simply put, you do not want to have the five worst polls
ever."**

## **🇮 🇷 **Iran War Updates

  * **Split decision:** John Fetterman's sole Democratic "no" meant the Senate [failed](https://x.com/sahilkapur/status/2054603779530793136?s=46) a seventh time to pass a measure to end Trump's war. Republican Lisa Murkowski switched to yes with one GOP senator absent. The measure went down 49-50.

  * **China crisis:** As Trump landed in Beijing to meet Xi Jinping, the _New York Times_ [reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/13/us/politics/china-iran-weapons-trump-xi.html) that U.S. officials say Chinese firms are plotting to sell arms to Iran. Meanwhile, a Chinese oil tanker [exited](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/chinese-supertanker-attempts-hormuz-passage-data-show-2026-05-13/) the Strait of Hormuz, controlled by Iran, after being stranded for two months. Trump later [hailed](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/5/14/trump-xi-summit-live-us-china-leaders-to-hold-talks-on-trade-tech-iran) the Chinese president a "great leader" and "friend" and [invited](https://apnews.com/live/trump-administration-updates-05-14-2026#0000019e-2614-d1f2-a99e-a7d64a390000) him to the White House.

  * **Talks talk:** Vice President Vance [said](https://www.reuters.com/video/watch/idRW035413052026RP1/) talks to end the war were "making progress" but Trump's "red line" was an end to Iran's nuclear program. An Iranian general [said](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/5/13/iran-war-live-trump-travels-to-china-as-conflict-with-tehran-looms-large) the country's military had "no room for retreat."

  * **Secret visit:** Benjamin Netanyahu secretly visited the UAE during operations against Iran, the Israeli prime minister's office [said](https://x.com/TreyYingst/status/2054609964241444959?s=20). The UAE [denied](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/13/netanyahu-visited-uae-in-secret-during-us-israel-war-on-iran-office-says) that the visit was secret.

  * **Lebanon latest:** Strikes on vehicles in southern Lebanon [killed 22 people](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1k2zekj8y9o), including eight children, the Health Ministry said, per the BBC. Continuing to ignore the supposed ceasefire, Israel claimed it hit Hezbollah targets and warned residents of nine villages to evacuate ahead of more strikes. The death toll has [topped](https://www.moph.gov.lb/en/Media/view/84565/1/-updated-total-toll-of-the-aggression-2896-martyrs-and-8824-wounded) 2,895 people.

Francesca Albanese, the United Nations special rapporteur on the situation of
human rights in the Palestinian territories, celebrated on Wednesday after a
federal judge [blocked](https://ecf.dcd.uscourts.gov/cgi-
bin/show_public_doc?2026cv0688-48) U.S. sanctions against her.

The Italian lawyer
[said](https://x.com/FranceskAlbs/status/2054678738126676308): "As the judge
says: 'Protecting the Freedom of speech is always just the public interest.'
Thanks to my daughter and my husband for stepping up to defend me, and
everyone who has helped so far. Together we are One."

Secretary of State Marco Rubio sanctioned Albanese in July 2025, after Trump
issued an executive order authorizing measures against anyone involved with
the International Criminal Court investigation of Israel's genocidal war in
Gaza.

Albanese's "offense" was to recommend war crimes prosecutions against Israeli
and U.S. nationals.

The sanctions barred Albanese from entering the U.S. or banking there. As she
previously lived in Washington, DC, while attached to the World Bank, and
maintains a house in the city, Albanese and her family faced serious problems.
In February this year, [Albanese told ](https://zeteo.com/p/francesca-
albanese-fake-video-gaza-board-of-peace-donald-trump-israel-genocide-united-
nations)**[Mehdi](https://zeteo.com/p/francesca-albanese-fake-video-gaza-
board-of-peace-donald-trump-israel-genocide-united-nations)**[ and a
](https://zeteo.com/p/francesca-albanese-fake-video-gaza-board-of-peace-
donald-trump-israel-genocide-united-
nations)**[Zeteo](https://zeteo.com/p/francesca-albanese-fake-video-gaza-
board-of-peace-donald-trump-israel-genocide-united-nations)**[ town hall
audience](https://zeteo.com/p/francesca-albanese-fake-video-gaza-board-of-
peace-donald-trump-israel-genocide-united-nations) about life under U.S.
sanctions, including how she could not "make any financial transaction." She
also discussed a crude video spread by pro-Israel groups attempting to paint
her as antisemitic.

Albanese's husband, Massimiliano Cali, and daughter, who is a U.S. citizen,
sued the Trump administration in U.S. District Court in Washington, DC. On
Wednesday, in his ruling, Judge Richard J. Leon wrote: "Protecting the freedom
of speech is 'always' in the public interest … That is so even when an
individual's views are 'hurtful,' 'caustic,' or 'even outrageous,' as
defendants clearly believe Albanese's speech to be … Indeed, the 'proudest
boast' of our First Amendment is that it protects the freedom to express even
'the thought that we hate…'

"Enough said."

## **🗞 ️ **What You Need to Know

  * **Fed led:** Kevin Warsh was [confirmed](https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/05/13/us/trump-news-updates) as the new Federal Reserve chair. Only one Senate Democrat - _Fetterman, obvs_ - backed Trump's pick, amid concern over the president's attacks on Fed independence.

  * **Legal news:** Trump's DOJ [sued](https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/justice-department-files-complaint-against-dc-bar-disciplinary-authorities-over-their) the Washington, DC, Bar for disciplining Jeffrey Clark, a government lawyer who worked on Trump's attempt to stay in power after losing the 2020 election. In Florida, Trump, state officials, and trustees of Miami Dade College were [sued](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/05/13/trump-library-project-faces-suit-around-hotel-remark-land-transfer/) over a land deal for Trump's presidential library.

  * **Et tu, Kash?:** After getting FBI Director Kash Patel to [agree](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2054271883823173801) to take a test to see if he has a drinking problem, Senator Chris Van Hollen [took](https://x.com/ChrisVanHollen/status/2054576877025509515?s=20) a test himself. Meanwhile, MS Now reported agents saying Patel is manipulating statistics [relating](https://www.ms.now/news/fbi-insiders-kash-patel-is-padding-the-stats-to-boost-his-record-of-arrests) to FBI arrests.

  * **Epstein update:** Howard Lutnick's House Oversight [transcript](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/read-the-full-transcript-of-howard-lutnicks-testimony-about-jeffrey-epstein) was released. Of the commerce secretary's attempts to explain issues including a visit to the late sex offender's island he first failed to mention, Democrat Ro Khanna said: "It was just contortions and lies… He made a farce of the English language."

  * **Drunken slurs:** Senator Rand Paul's son, William Paul, made antisemitic comments to GOP congressman Mike Lawler at a DC bar, NOTUS [reported](https://www.notus.org/congress/william-paul-mike-lawler-confrontation-antisemitism), adding that Paul said he was "really drunk" and told Lawler to "watch more Tucker Carlson." Lawler isn't Jewish. Paul [apologized](https://x.com/TastyBrew1776/status/2054658199840559352) and said he was seeking help.

  * **ICE impunity:** A witness to a [homicide](https://www.texastribune.org/2026/01/21/texas-el-paso-immigrant-death-ice-custody-homicide/) at a Texas ICE facility whose [account ](https://zeteo.com/p/texas-ice-homicide-choking-guards)**[Zeteo](https://zeteo.com/p/texas-ice-homicide-choking-guards)** published had his appeal dismissed and was ordered removed from the U.S., **Zeteo** learned. In Colorado, a judge [said](https://x.com/rgoodlaw/status/2054595875981205732?s=46) ICE is violating court orders, including by making and failing to document warrantless arrests.

  * **Power play:** Nearly 50,000 Lake Tahoe residents must find a new energy source as their current supplier will feed data centers instead, _Fortune_[reported](https://fortune.com/2026/05/12/lake-tahoe-data-center-49000-residents-power-source/).

## **😳** WTF?!

  
Before Doug Burgum became Trump's interior secretary, he was governor of North
Dakota, a state that [produces](https://www.eia.gov/states/ND/analysis) a lot
of energy, renewable sources included.

But he doesn't seem to know how solar power works.

Appearing before the House Natural Resources Committee, Burgum, who has
extensive oil and gas ties, sought to cast doubt on solar projects.

Addressing the California Democrat Jared Huffman, [the secretary
said](http://x.com/atrupar/status/2054578539375042613): "All of these projects
you are describing in Nevada have one thing in common: When the sun goes down,
they produce zero electricity… the whole machine doesn't work when the sun
goes down."

Huffman requested "unanimous consent to enter in the record this amazing new
technology that apparently the secretary is unaware of: It's a battery."

Bruce Westerman, the committee's Republican chair, smirked.

Burgum [stayed stone-faced](http://x.com/atrupar/status/2054578539375042613).
